New York City

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
x <- read_csv("data/nyc_tracts.csv")
```


```{r}
x %>%
  group_by(race) %>%
  summarize(avg_income = mean(med_income, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(race, -avg_income), y = avg_income, fill = race)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Median Income by Race",
    x = "Race",
    y = "Average Median Income (USD)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar)
```
